% Shared preamble: the parts that are yours to change.  The macro
% contract lives in pset.tex, generated by `pset --init`; this file
% inputs it and then styles the result through its hooks.
%
% The path is relative to the document being built, which sits one folder
% down, not to this file.
\input{../pset.tex}

% typical blue underlined hyperrefs
\hypersetup{pdfborder={0 0 0}, urlcolor=blue, colorlinks=true}

% \sol and \rub as tcolorboxes.  Drop these two and both still hide and
% reveal correctly, just unadorned.
\renewcommand{\solstyle}[1]{
	\begin{tcolorbox}[colback=blue!3!white,colframe=blue!40!black,title=Solution,breakable]
		#1
	\end{tcolorbox}
}

\renewcommand{\rubstyle}[1]{
	\begin{tcolorbox}[colback=green!3!white,colframe=green!40!black,title=Rubric,breakable]
		#1
	\end{tcolorbox}
}

% define header
\def\myboxA#1{\vbox{\hrule height0.8pt\hbox{\vrule width0.8pt\kern1pt
			\vbox{\kern1pt#1\kern1pt}\kern1pt\vrule width0.8pt}\hrule height0.8pt}}

\def\myboxB#1{\vbox{\hrule height0.8pt\hbox{\vrule width0.8pt\kern2pt
			\vbox{\kern2pt#1\kern2pt}\kern2pt\vrule width0.8pt}\hrule height0.8pt}}

\def\titlebox#1{\myboxA{\myboxB{\vbox{\hsize \textwidth \noindent #1}}}}

\def\headerDate#1{\centerline{\titlebox{%
			\course \hfill  \prof \linebreak
			\semester \hfill \hwdateassign}}}

% fighere
\providecommand{\fighere}[2]{
	\begin{figure}[H]
		\centering
		\includegraphics[#1]{#2}
	\end{figure}}
